conviction_note: The Q3 sales numbers are new (nothing was pre-released, unlike Q1 on 2026-04-07 and H1 on 2026-07-01), so abs_move is set from Kebni's own observed report-day moves (median about 7%, -13.1% at worst on the Q4 report) and pushed up for $109k a day of turnover and a single commissioned analyst. The sign is close to a coin: no pre-release and the stated Inertial recovery lean up, a quarter with no SatCom platform order and a placement overhang lean down, so the findings net to zero and p_up is 48. findings.finding: Kebni pre-released its Q1 (7 days after quarter end) and H1 (1 day after) sales misses through separate 'uppdatering avseende det finansiella utfallet' releases, stated in the Q2 report that it expects 'a full recovery in Q3' in Inertial Sensing, and had issued no Q3 update 20 days after quarter end. Q3 sales therefore probably did not deviate materially from what the company itself expected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Report day after a pre-released miss: Q1 2026 (2026-04-23) +7.4%. Report days without a pre-release: Q3 2025 -8.0% on 'solid but quiet' 30.4 MSEK, Q4 2025 -13.1%, Q2 2026 -4.75% (after the Jul 1 pre-release). Pre-release days themselves: -12.3% (Apr 7) and -7.8% (Jul 1). Moves computed from Yahoo daily closes.
findings.original_quote: Bolaget bedömer nu att nettoomsättningen för första halvåret 2026 kommer att understiga motsvarande period föregående år och därmed den bedömning som lämnades i april. [...] Bolaget kan nu konstatera att återhämtningen har utvecklats enligt plan. (The company now assesses that H1 2026 net sales will fall short of the prior-year period and thus of the assessment given in April. [...] The company can now confirm that the recovery has progressed according to plan.)
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference from an absence, and the market reads it the other way: the stock fell 23% in 20 sessions with no news at all. If the market had read 'no profit warning = no miss', the stock would not have sat at fresh lows into the print. The weakness is that Kebni never gave a Q3 number, so there was nothing formal to deviate from.
findings.independence: The Q2 report states 'We expect a full recovery in Q3, and no orders have been lost' and announces the 22 MSEK NLAW order (https://mfn.se/a/kebni/kebni-secures-22-msek-order-to-deliver-tailored-sensor-units-for-saabs-nlaw, 2026-08-11). Same issuer, different document.

findings.finding: Between the Q2 report and 2026-10-20 Kebni announced no SatCom platform order (only a 1.3 MSEK spare-parts order on 2026-07-21), although it announces orders as small as 1.3 and 5.2 MSEK. The 'delayed' SatCom orders behind the Q1 and H1 misses therefore still had not landed, and the release's SatCom timing commentary will likely push them further out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025, a quarter with no new orders ('Solid but quiet quarter, orders remain key' per DNB Carnegie): -8.0%. Q2 2026, SatCom delay restated: -4.75%. Q4 2025: -13.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The order silence is public, the commissioned analyst titled its preview 'Focus shifts to 2027', and the stock is -23% over 20 days and -41% over 60. What is not priced is what the CEO says about timing: a slip with no date, or a named loss, would be new. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: DNB Carnegie Q3 preview title 'Focus shifts to 2027' (https://placera.se/externa-analyser/kebni-kebni-focus-shifts-to-2027-q3-preview-20261016, 2026-10-16) points the same way. MFN's issuer list shows the same order silence (https://mfn.se/all/a/kebni).

findings.finding: The SEK 55m directed issue at SEK 0.80 closed in Q3 (tranche 2 paid by 2026-09-17), taking the balance sheet from -6.9 MSEK net cash at Q2 to an estimated net-cash position. The stated use is mainly doubling Inertial Sensing capacity (~45%) and SatCom development (~35%), and the 22 MSEK NLAW volume order with deliveries through 2027 corroborates the Inertial ramp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Placement announcement day 2026-08-28: -20.0% (open 0.846 against the 0.80 issue price).
findings.why_not_priced: The raise is public and its dilution was priced in on the day. The release adds only confirmation that the going-concern / cash question is closed. The stock trading 23% below the issue price suggests the market reads the raise as overhang, not as fuel, which is why this is sized near zero.
findings.independence: EGM communique confirming tranche 2 and payment by 2026-09-17 (https://mfn.se/a/kebni/kommunike-fran-kebni-ab-s-extra-bolagsstamma-den-16-september-2026, 2026-09-16, sv): 'Betalning och teckning ska ske senast den 17 september 2026'

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +1.16 from the -23% 20-day run-up (mean-reversion). My findings net to 0 and do not add to it; the drawdown has no documented cause, so I do not treat it as an edge in either direction.
language_note: The Q1 and H1 2026 sales pre-releases, which set Kebni's warning pattern (and so make the absence of a Q3 one informative), were published only in Swedish ('Kebni AB (publ) lämnar uppdatering avseende det finansiella utfallet...'); the English sources carry them only as one line inside the Q2 report.
The EGM communique confirming tranche 2 payment by 2026-09-17 was Swedish-only.
Otherwise nothing: Kebni files its reports and order releases in English, and the Swedish press carried no Kebni-specific story.
lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 8 to 9: the Q3 numbers are new, not pre-released (European base about 7%); thin coverage and $109k turnover; 'understatement is the hunters' systematic error'. The reaction history moves p_up, not abs_move.
The SatCom-timing finding is kept on the guidance line ('the move is in the guide'), not on the reported quarter; its size is unchanged.
The October drawdown is not filed as a finding ('a drawdown with no cause in the filings is worth 0'), consistent with the draft.
Finding sizes are unchanged; impact_sum stays 0.0.
